opening.argument: The presentation places Bitclub in cryptocurrency trading and arbitrage, then ties financial participation to packages spread across exchanges, including a $25,000 VIP tier. The speaker says, “we're gonna have all these packages so we're gonna have millions across all the exchanges,” while describing the VIP package as providing a higher percentage and advance notice of trades. Viewers are told they can put in money for passive monthly income, with an expectation of up to 10% a month, and that gains can be compounded repeatedly. The presentation directs beginners to a link and urges them to take action. Although profits are expressly not promised and the robot is described as a future launch, those qualifications do not remove the central promotion of investing funds in connection with substantial projected returns.
